text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Thanks so much for helping my son and
his wife
with their move.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it! You're always doing so
much for
us, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think we'd have everything done
by noon,
but having two people on it
really helped speed
things along.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, we sure like to compete a whole
lot, but
working together like this isn't
too bad, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Well, if we were always
cooperating like
this, I'd get thrown off
my game.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. I'm sure I've got some
ohagi
cakes around here, so why don't
you eat those
before you head home?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, looks like there's three left. I've
only just
had breakfast, so you two share
them between
yourselves.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Take two of them, Vodka. I'm sure
you're tired
after carrying that big chest
of drawers.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No, no, you were the one lugging that
fridge
around. You should take two.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that was no trouble at all. You must
be more fatigued than me. I definitely
heard you let out a
sigh after you were
done.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry? Who was the one grunting
and trying
to psyche herself up the
whole time?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That was just for encouragement! I was
saying
"Phew!" to sympathize with you
after all that
physical labor you endured!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Now you're splitting hairs! That was
nowhere near
enough work to tire me
out! Just hurry up and
take them!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'll have you know that I'm not tired in the least! They're all yours, Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Grrrrr!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Just glaring at each other won't get us
anywhere!
Let's compete to see who's
more worn out!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Very well! How about a one-lap race
around the
neighborhood then?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on! This spot's the finish line!
Whoever's
more tired by the end gets
the extra cake!

text_block_list.name: Vodka & Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Rrrraaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Elderly Storekeeper
text_block_list.text:
...Goodness.
It's nice that they're so full
of
energy.
